fusions.name: Ringing Slam
fusions.desc: Slams down, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning each for 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Chisel
fusions.desc: A hard strike that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Hardened Shelf
fusions.desc: Grows a hard shelf of reef over you that absorbs the next 30 damage, up to 3 blows, and holds for 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Unrusting
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you have 8% physical resistance.
